name: Fly from the live globe into the Eagle S case
description: Validates /live: the recorded day loads on the 3D globe with its frames, ship count and clock, the Eagle S incident opens its card, and Fly to the seabed lands on the case console at the cut's minute with the cut card open.

planSteps.description: Navigate to /live and wait up to 60 seconds for the globe (data-testid live-globe-view) to reach data-state "ready"
Assert the stage (data-testid live-globe) has a data-frame-count of at least 1 and shows the label "A recorded day of ships, not real time"
Assert, within 60 seconds, the ship count (data-testid live-ship-count) shows a whole number above 0 and the clock (data-testid live-clock) reads a time in the form HH:MM UTC
In the card "Cable cuts on file" (data-testid live-incidents), click the Eagle S row (data-testid live-incident-eagle-s-2024)

Assert the incident card (data-testid live-incident-card) opens with data-slug "eagle-s-2024", reads "Eagle S anchor drag", names the cut "Estlink 2" and the time "10:26 UTC", and the Eagle S row has aria-current="true"
Click "Fly to the seabed" (data-testid live-incident-dive) and wait up to 60 seconds for the page to change

Assert the URL path is /cases/eagle-s-2024 with t=2024-12-25T10:26Z and layer=cut-estlink-2 in the query, the replay console (data-testid replay-console) is shown, and a card (data-testid cut-card) titled "Estlink 2 cut" is open
